theorem.name: SelectedChernSequenceAndFiniteAPosterioriStabilityTheorem
theorem.statement: The selected global Dolbeault extension form and positive determinant-one metric sequence determine a unique global Chern-connection sequence; the offdiagonal term is fixed by eta_00 and is not a free coefficient. At the 24^4 projected level the HYM residual is 8.21e-13 and the zero-mean linearization has coercivity margin about 26.02, giving residual-over-coercivity indicator 3.16e-14. A continuum uniform truncation/patchwise bound is still required for the literal global HYM witness.
